name: TWIST'EM
description: Twist'em (Double-Hand Dominoes) is a casino banking game played with a double-six domino set. Each player and the banker receive three tiles and arrange them into a top hand and a bottom hand (pip totals mod 10, nine high). Players bet against the banker; both hands must outrank the banker's two hands to win. Based on Pai Gow but with Western dominoes.

Casino table game designed and patented by Olympian Gaming; Western domino version of Pai Gow.
2-9 (one banker or house banks; up to eight others bet).
Each player places a bet and receives three tiles; banker receives three tiles.

items.text: House bank: House or casino is the permanent bank; collects percentage of wins.
Player bank: Player-banker position rotates; fee collected prior to deal.
